posts.trend: UPI MDR For Capital Markets: Why A Tiny Fee Could Test India’s Zero-brokerage Model
posts.context: The illusion of active capital market investment hides the reality of being a rent-extracted consumer.
posts.angle: You are not an active market participant; you are a captive source of micro-transaction fees for platforms that never lose money.
slides: Try finding the 'free' button on your investment app today.

Your portfolio: down 4%.

The platform fee: up 18%.

The GST on your transaction: mandatory.

Your broker's profit: guaranteed.

You are just a database row.

The platform is the only winner.
posts.caption: But congratulations on your diversification strategy. 📈
posts.rank_verdict: The landing states the obvious moral of the post rather than letting the deadpan speak for itself.
